'''Unstable wight footsoldiers''' are monsters fought during [[Sliske's Endgame]]. They are summoned by [[Sliske]] toward the end of the first wave of the combat section at the end of the quest. They are the strongest enemies in the wave, and will explode upon death, dealing damage to all adjacent targets (the player and other wights).
